denial_info.denial_reason_text: MRI of the lumbar spine denied as not medically necessary; payer policy requires 6 weeks of failed conservative management or progressive neurological findings.

evidence.fact: Patient completed 8 weeks of structured physical therapy with minimal improvement — exceeds the payer's 6-week requirement.
evidence.quote_from_note: She has completed eight (8) weeks of structured physical therapy (01/05/2026–02/27/2026) with minimal improvement.

evidence.fact: New progressive neurological findings: diminished left Achilles reflex and 4/5 EHL strength.
evidence.quote_from_note: Left Achilles reflex diminished (1+) versus right (2+). Strength 4/5 left extensor hallucis longus.

evidence.fact: Positive tension sign with dermatomal sensory loss — meets the payer's red-flag criterion.
evidence.quote_from_note: Straight-leg raise positive on the left at 40 degrees, reproducing her calf pain.

evidence.fact: Ordering clinician explicitly tied the MRI to failed conservative care and progressive findings.
evidence.quote_from_note: Given eight weeks of failed conservative management and new progressive motor and reflex findings on exam, I am ordering an MRI
